name: far_corner
conceit: One overhead survey world (the whole Bethesda complex, tracked to the far corner, tracked to the red path) covered by a single continuous $0 camera across the whole runtime -- no per-scene cuts to new generations; even the closing 'red survey path' plate is code-drawn (a PIL hand-wobbled dashed line + tick marks + endpoint dot) onto the FIRST plate rather than a fourth AI generation. Only the two narration-mandated motion beats (the water stirring, the man rising) get a paid Kling insert.

anti: no real spatial distance or isolation to measure -- an interior single-room scene gives the overhead survey nothing to plot
scenes that need the viewer to read a face up close -- the overhead framing flattens every figure to a small distant mark

plate_bill.must_contain: overhead cutaway of the whole Bethesda complex: pool ringed by 5 covered colonnaded porches, dozens of huddled sick figures on mats, faint survey-grid overlay
overhead track along one porch: rows of sick figures thinning to one man utterly alone in the far corner, measured-distance survey line with tick marks
overhead close pair: the lone man on his mat and a standing figure (Jesus) beside him, unhurried, distant pool visible at frame edge

derived_views: survey_path_overlay(from=far_corner_01, code-drawn red dashed hand-wobbled line + tick marks + endpoint dot -> final_plate.png)

motion_slots.earned_by: only the two beats the narration itself puts in motion -- the water stirring and the man standing -- get a paid 5s Kling insert; every other beat rides the $0 camera over the already-rendered overhead stills.

risk_flags: no_baked_text -- far_corner_02's own shipped prompt asked for a hand-lettered '38' distance numeral in the same breath as the guardrail's own 'no visible text or lettering' clause; if rebuilt, that numeral must be added by CODE (like the survey path itself), never baked into the generation prompt
accuracy_spec: John 5:2-5 -- Bethesda has FIVE covered porches around the pool (not a generic arbitrary count), and the man had been impotent 38 years -- any distance/measurement numeral used in the device must trace to this verse, never an invented figure.

beat_template.hook: the whole complex, overhead, dense with the sick, oriented toward the water
beat_template.pivot: track the length of one porch to the one man utterly alone in the far corner, the measured distance the point
beat_template.landing: pull back on the red survey path from crowd to corner -- code-drawn, not a new generation -- resolved and still

score_shape: a hushed, waiting cue under the overhead survey push, thinning to near-silence at the isolated far corner, then a single warm swell entering with the standing figure and holding through the pull-back landing.
